title: Lead Automation Engineer
description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**

\&\#xa;
Job Description
  

Lead Automation Engineer to manage and deliver the complete automation scope for a Greenfield manufacturing facility, from Basic Design through Detailed Engineering, Procurement Support, Installation, FAT, SAT, Commissioning, and Handover.
  

The role requires strong technical and leadership experience in industrial automation systems with clear accountability for Safety, Quality, Schedule, and Cost. The Lead Automation Engineer will act as the single\-point owner for automation packages, manage delayed package recovery, and control Scope Change Orders (SCOs) related to automation.
  

Tasks and responsibilities
  

1\. Design Management (Basic to Detailed Engineering)
  

Lead Basic and Detailed Automation Engineering activities with OEMs, system integrators, and internal SMEs.
  

Ensure completeness and quality of P\&IDs, Control Narratives, I/O Lists, Instrument Index, Logic Diagrams, and HMI philosophies.
  

Leading an area with a team\- setting direction, planning, execution \& handover.
  

Review and approve automation deliverables for constructability, operability, maintainability, and compliance.
  

Drive Design Reviews and ensure outputs support timely procurement and installation.
  

2\. Automation Package Execution (DCS / PLC / SCADA / Batch Systems)
  

Act as technical owner for automation systems including DCS, PLC, SCADA, EMS, and Batch Management systems as applicable.
  

Define and review Batch Automation architecture in line with ISA\-88/95 standards.
  

Acting as subject matter experts in own discipline.
  

Supervising/Development of functional specification of complex units.
  

Lead implementation of Batch Manager / Batch Executive systems including recipe design, master recipes, control recipes, and equipment models.
  

Supervising/Developing DCS application coding based on programming standards and design guidelines.
  

Coordinate with Process owners for software development, batch configuration, documentation, licenses, and spares.
  

Ensure alignment of automation and batch system deliveries with project schedule and construction readiness.
  

3\. Installation, FAT, SAT, and Commissioning Support
  

Plan, execute, and lead Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) for both continuous and batch automation systems, including recipe testing and batch execution scenarios.
  

Support site installation activities such as panel installation, cabling, loop checks, and system power\-up.
  

Lead or support Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), batch logic testing, interlock verification, and commissioning activities.
  

Support batch process dry runs, water batches, and process simulation prior to live production.
  

Ensure structured automation and batch system handover including as\-built documents, recipes, backups, passwords, and operator training.
  

4\. Safety, Quality, and Compliance Assurance
  

Enforce strict adherence to EHS protocols at all phases — zero compromise on safety.
  

Ensure implementation of QA/QC standards, including ITPs, checklists, audits, and NCR closures.
  

Coordinate with Safety and Quality teams to ensure all works meet regulatory and internal standards.
  

5\. Schedule Control (Non\-Negotiable)
  

Own automation milestones within the Integrated Master Schedule.
  

Develop and track 2W / 4W / 6W look\-ahead schedules for automation engineering, FAT, SAT, and commissioning.
  

Identify schedule risks early and drive recovery plans for delayed automation packages or vendo
  

6\. Cost Control and Scope Change Order (SCO) Management
  

Monitor automation package costs against approved budgets.
  

Evaluate technical impact of scope changes, design modifications, and recovery actions.
  

Act as automation focal point for SCO documentation, justification, impact analysis, and approvals.
  

7\. Risk Management \& Early Forecasting
  

Maintain a live project risk register with active mitigation plans.
  

Proactively identify interface risks with Process, Electrical, Instrumentation, IT/OT, Utilities, and Validation teams.
  

Escalate risks that could impact commissioning readiness or plant start\-up timelines.
  

8\. Project Governance \& Stakeholder Management
  

Organize and lead status meetings, design reviews, site reviews, and cross\-functional syncs.
  

Coordinate with vendors, consultants, internal teams, and Global Team.
  

repair and present weekly and monthly automation status reports, dashboards, and recovery trackers.
  

Basic Qualifications
  

Bachelor’s Degree in Instrumentation, Electrical, Electronics, or Automation Engineering.
  

Minimum 10–15 years of experience in industrial automation project execution.
  

Proven experience in Greenfield projects from design through commissioning.
  

Strong working experience with PLC/DCS/SCADA systems (ABB 800xA, Emerson or equivalent).
  

Proven experience in Batch Automation and Batch Management systems (ISA\-88/95\), including recipe configuration, unit procedures, phases, and batch execution.
  

Process engineering knowledge for liquid systems (pumps, valves, CIP/SIP)
  

Knowledge of ABB800xA system, ABB Batch manager, PCDL, PCEL libraries would be an added advantage.
  

Strong Design/functional specification (CM, EM \&Phases class) Experience \& application development for recipes would be preferable.
  

Hands\-on experience in FAT, SAT, commissioning, IQ, OQ and vendor coordination.
  

Familiarity with EPCM project execution models and engineerin

title: Test Automation Engineer
description:
**Project Role :** Test Automation Engineer  

**Project Role Description :** Use quality processes, automation tools, and methodologies to transform testing products and solutions. Run end\-to\-end quality engineering function with a focus on automation to improve control, accuracy and integrity.
  

**Must have skills :** Playwright  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **7\.5** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

As a Test Automation Engineer, a typical day involves designing, developing, and implementing automation solutions to ensure high\-quality software delivery across financial and trading platforms. The role focuses on leading automation initiatives, developing and maintaining automated test frameworks, and executing functional, regression, integration, UAT, and performance testing. Working closely with Product Management, Development, and Business teams, the engineer drives quality throughout the software development lifecycle while leveraging automation best practices to deliver reliable and scalable software solutions.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:
  

* Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.
* Responsible for team decisions.
* Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
* Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.
* Lead efforts to identify process improvements and implement automation best practices.
* Mentor junior team members to support their professional growth and technical development.
* Coordinate cross\-functional activities to ensure alignment and timely delivery of quality objectives.
* Design, develop, maintain, and execute automated test cases and regression suites using the organization's automation framework.
* Lead functional, regression, UAT, and performance testing activities across financial and trading applications.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Development, and Business teams to create automation strategies based on business requirements.
* Report, track, and manage software defects and testing activities throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).
* Contribute to release management activities, including validation of application releases and environment support.
* Promote QA standards, automation best practices, and continuous quality improvements across the team.

  

Professional \& Technical Skills:
  

Must To Have Skills:  

* Proficiency in Playwright, Investment Banking, VeriFix, FIX Protocol, Jira, and Test Case Management tools.
* Strong experience in designing, developing, and implementing automated test scripts using Playwright and VeriFix.
* Extensive knowledge of FIX Protocol and experience working with FIX\-based trading applications.
* Strong understanding of automation testing frameworks, regression automation, and continuous integration pipelines.
* Experience creating, maintaining, and executing automated test cases based on business and functional requirements.
* Experience converting manual regression test cases into automated test scripts.
* Strong understanding of Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), Agile methodologies, and Quality Assurance processes.
* Ability to analyze complex systems, troubleshoot defects, and provide automation solutions.
* Experience with bug tracking tools such as Jira and Test Case Management tools.
* Strong understanding of financial markets, investment banking, and trading platforms.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.


Good To Have Skills:  

* Experience with HP UFT.
* Experience with User Acceptance Testing (UAT), performance testing, and regression testing.
* Knowledge of Fixed Income and Derivatives products.
* Experience supporting release management and application version upgrades.
* Experience working in fast\-paced financial market environments.

  

Additional Information:
  

* The candidate should have minimum 7\.5 years of experience in VeriFix, FIX Protocol, Market Data, Playwright.
* This position is based at our Pune Magarpatta office, 2 days in a week.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

  

15 years full time education

title: Test Automation Engineer
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


The IT Quality Sr Analyst is a seasoned professional role. Applies in\-depth disciplinary knowledge, contributing to the development of new techniques and the improvement of processes and work\-flow for the area or function. Integrates subject matter and industry expertise within a defined area. Requires in\-depth understanding of how areas collectively integrate within the sub\-function as well as coordinate and contribute to the objectives of the function and overall business. Evaluates moderately complex and variable issues with substantial potential impact, where development of an approach/taking of an action involves weighing various alternatives and balancing potentially conflicting situations using multiple sources of information. Requires good analytical skills in order to filter, prioritize and validate potentially complex and dynamic material from multiple sources. Strong communication and diplomacy skills are required. Regularly assumes informal/formal leadership role within teams. Involved in coaching and training of new recruits Significant impact in terms of project size, geography, etc. by influencing decisions through advice, counsel and/or facilitating services to others in area of specialization. Work and performance of all teams in the area are directly affected by the performance of the individual.
  

  

**Responsibilities:**


* Responsible for initiatives related to User Acceptance Testing (UAT) process and product rollout into production, making recommendations of solutions and improvements. Responsibilities may also include software quality assurance testing.
* Conducts complex process monitoring, product evaluation and audit assignments; reports issues and makes recommendations for solutions.
* Ensures project standards and procedures exist, are fully / clearly documented and followed throughout the software development life cycle; makes recommendations for enhanced documentation.
* Monitors products for conformance to standards; monitors processes for conformance to procedures; identifies risks and recommends solutions; ensures annual organizational reviews of standards and procedures are conducted.
* Documents findings and performs root cause analyses to provide recommended improvements. Independently recommends solutions and improvements to existing standards and procedures; collaborates with other areas in technology to develop new standards and procedures.
* Ensures all corrective actions are assigned, documented and completed. Verifies traceability in project work products. Gathers, maintains and creates reports on quality metrics.
* Exhibits sound understanding of concepts and principles in own technical area and a basic knowledge of these elements in other areas.
* Requires in\-depth understanding of how own area integrates within IT Quality and has basic commercial awareness.
* Acts as advisor and mentor for junior members of the team.
* Makes evaluative judgments based on analysis of factual information in complicated and novel situations and provides solutions to problems.
* Has direct impact on the team and closely related teams by ensuring the quality of the tasks/services/information provided by self and others.
* Requires sound and comprehensive communication and diplomacy skills to exchange complex information.
* Performs other duties and functions as assigned.
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

**Qualifications:**


* 8\+ years experience in an IT Quality role.
* Demonstrated execution capabilities.
* Development experience in a fast\-paced, time\-to\-market driven environment Experience with test automation, test scenario and test scripts creation and modification Comfortable with writing complex queries Experience with reporting tools. Hands on experience with testing automation tools.
* Project management experience preferred

**Education:**


* Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience

Must be excellent in Java, Python, SQL, Selenium, AI Tools (e.g. Devin). Must have hands on test automation coding skills. Should be able to focus on shift left automation. CICD knowledge is a must. Performance testing knowledge is an added advantage.
